_comment: ScanToBIM — Dynamic Element Type Classification Rules.
Rules in this file are evaluated by classifier.py BEFORE the built-in rules.
Add new equipment types here without touching classifier.py or models.py code.
Rule schema:
element_type  [required] — must match an ElementType enum value in models.py
description              — human-readable note (ignored by code)
priority                 — lower number = evaluated first (default 50)
shape                    — 'cylinder' | 'box' | 'any' (default 'any')
conditions               — all listed conditions must pass for a match:
min_diameter_mm / max_diameter_mm   — average of two minor bounding-box dims
min_aspect_ratio / max_aspect_ratio — major_dim / diameter
min_major_mm / max_major_mm         — longest bounding-box dimension
min_volume_m3 / max_volume_m3       — bounding-box volume in cubic metres
min_centroid_z_mm / max_centroid_z_mm — vertical centroid elevation
min_minor1_mm / max_minor1_mm       — smallest bounding-box dimension (box shape)
min_minor2_mm / max_minor2_mm       — middle bounding-box dimension (box shape)
discipline_overrides:
Maps element_type value → Discipline enum value ('mep', 'structural', etc.)
Only needed for types NOT already in the built-in discipline mapping.
safety_overrides:
Maps element_type value → safety classification dict.
Keys: safety_category (SC1/SC2/SC3/NS), dsear_zone (Zone0/Zone1/Zone2/None), reason.
